import inspect
import os
from pathlib import Path
from click import format_filename

assert inspect.signature(format_filename).parameters['normalize_slashes'].kind is inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY
for value in [r'C:\one\two.txt', b'C:\\one\\two.txt', Path('one') / 'two.txt', b'one\\\xff.txt', 'one\\\udcff.txt']:
    for shorten in (False, True):
        original = os.path.basename(value) if shorten else os.fspath(value)
        if isinstance(original, bytes):
            import sys
            original = original.decode(sys.getfilesystemencoding(), 'replace')
        else:
            original = original.encode('utf-8', 'surrogateescape').decode('utf-8', 'replace')
        assert format_filename(value, shorten) == original
        assert format_filename(value, shorten, normalize_slashes=False) == original
        assert format_filename(value, shorten, normalize_slashes=True) == original.replace('\\', '/')
'@ | python -; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests\test_utils.py -k filename }; git --no-pager diff --check; git --no-pager diff --stat

arguments.command:
@'
import difflib
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/click/utils.py')
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:src/click/utils.py']).splitlines(keepends=True)
new = p.read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)
matcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, [x.rstrip(b'\r\n') for x in old], [x.rstrip(b'\r\n') for x in new])
result = []
for tag, a, b, c, d in matcher.get_opcodes():
    result.extend(old[a:b] if tag == 'equal' else new[c:d])
p.write_bytes(b''.join(result))
'@ | python -; git --no-pager diff --check; git --no-pager diff --stat
arguments.description: Preserve original mixed line endings and verify minimal change
